style.vernacular: Equatorial highland capital at about 1,795 m: a compact CBD of 1920s-70s colonial, Art Deco and modernist blocks (cream, white and grey painted render and concrete) now ringed by glass-and-concrete towers and malls; suburbs of walled bungalows and flat blocks in cream render with red-brown, green or grey corrugated metal roofs; red-brown earth and mature jacaranda, fig and acacia trees throughout.
style.ornament: Colonial-era Gothic Revival and neoclassical civic buildings (Parliament clock tower, All Saints), 1930s Art Deco market halls, 1970s concrete modernist landmarks (KICC cylinder, cone and cuboid forms), South Asian carved-stone mandirs and mosques in Parklands and Ngara, thatched makuti-style pavilions in safari and restaurant settings.

sources.what: Climate (subtropical highland, 1,795 m), 'Green City under the Sun', KICC (1973, cuboid halls, cylindrical tower, cone forms, concrete core and glass walls), Parliament, City Hall, Holy Family Cathedral, tree-rich suburbs, 1948 master plan
1950s concrete-and-steel neoclassical Parliament with English-style clock tower
open grassland, scattered acacia, highland dry forest on the western uplands
